task: Go through my inbox and find the things I need to do for my kids' school, and see whether the app will keep watching for school forms for me from now on.
transcript: Opened the app: a Home screen asking 'What can I help with?' with three example requests and a note that nothing is sent without my OK.
Tapped Send by accident before typing; nothing happened.
Typed 'go through my inbox and find the things i need to do for the kids school. and can you keep watching for school forms from now on?' and tapped Send; the button read 'Sending'.
After 30s the Home list showed 'Find school tasks in your inbox: Working on it'.

After another minute it had split my ask into several items: 'Hudson Prep 7th grade application', 'Never miss a school form', 'Ezra's missing work and science lab report', and one I did not ask for, 'Open enrollment for medical, dental and FSA', all 'Working on it'.
Scrolled down: 'Find school tasks in your inbox' was Ready: 'I found 8 school things. The first one is due today: Rafi's zoo field trip permission slip and $15 (Ms. Ortiz).'

Tapped it: a list by child. Rafi: zoo slip and $15 today, picture day order form Thu Nov 19, 2 missing reading logs. Ezra: conference sign-ups Sun Nov 15 7pm (reminder 6:30), science lab report Mon Nov 16, emergency contact form Tue Nov 17, 3 missing math worksheets and a C+. Hudson Prep: Ezra's application due Sun Nov 22, my parent statement is the only missing part.
Ezra's part was one long paragraph with the numbers 4. 5. 6. 7. run together in the text, harder to read than Rafi's part.
Tapped 'All' once and nothing changed; tapped '‹ All' and got back to the list.
Tapped 'Never miss a school form': 'Working on it', with a note that reading email and calendar can take a few minutes.

After about a minute: 'I'm watching for school forms now. I check your email every morning and tell you about each new form, then remind you again a day or two before it's due,' plus the four forms due soon with reminder dates.

Asked 'anything for Noa?'; after about 3 minutes it said there are no school forms for Noa, her piano recital is Wed Nov 18 6-7:30pm (reminder at 4pm), she said she is vegetarian now, and no emails from her school were found, so tell it the school name if it writes elsewhere.
Went back to the list and saw the 'Hudson Prep' and 'Open enrollment' items had finished too.

Opened Ezra's item: a clear list of his missing work, a note that Sunday night is best for the lab report because of his Monday dentist visit, reminders it will set, and a 'Draft email, not sent' to the school office for Mr. Brandt that I would send myself.
stumbles: One message turned into five separate items on Home, including 'Open enrollment for medical, dental and FSA', which is not about school and I did not ask for. I had to scroll and open several to find my answers.
Ezra's part of the main answer was one run-on paragraph with list numbers (4. 5. 6. 7.) stuck inside the text, while Rafi's part was a clean list.
The '‹ All' back button did nothing the first time I tapped 'All'.
The follow-up about Noa took about 3 minutes, longer than ChatGPT.
The Ezra note had a lowercase 'do you want to send this' mid-sentence, which looked slightly unfinished.
verdict: I typed one sentence and got a correct, useful list of school to-dos for each kid, plus a clear promise that it checks my email every morning for new forms and will remind me before each one is due. It took a few minutes and spread the answer across several items (one about health insurance I never asked for), but nothing went out without me, and I could see the draft email was not sent.
